name: finflow
description: Full-stack personal finance tracker — Next.js, Node.js, MongoDB

scripts.dev: concurrently --names SERVER,CLIENT --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.start: concurrently --names SERVER,CLIENT --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm start --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client"
